name: yidam-vscode
description: Editor surface for a yidam-derived knowledge repository.

yidam.path.markdownDescription:
Absolute path to the `yidam` binary. Leave empty to resolve from `PATH`, then from the workspace's mise shims.

The extension never downloads or builds a binary: `.yidam.toml` records which yidam governs this corpus, and only it gets to say.

yidam.lint.showBaselined.markdownDescription:
Show violations the committed baseline already records, as faded Hints.

They are inherited debt rather than regressions and never fail CI. A repository carrying a lot of it can turn them off — the debt is still in `.yidam/lint-baseline.yml` and still in the gate, so nothing a reader needs is lost.

yidam.diagnostics.debounceMs.markdownDescription: How long to wait after a save before re-running the reports. They walk the whole corpus per run.
